layers.title: Depth to bedrock
layers.status: NO LIVE TILE/QUERY SERVICE FOUND for Ontario - needs an offline pipeline step

point_query.method: none live; bake into static raster (PMTiles/COG) via pipeline

options.title: OGS MRD207 Bedrock Topography and Overburden Thickness Mapping, Southern Ontario (Gao et al. 2006)
options.access: Download only - https://www.geologyontario.mines.gov.on.ca/persistent-linking?publication=MRD207 (record verified in OGS Publications index service). Clip to PEC and tile in pipeline.
options.why: Ontario-specific, built from water-well, borehole and outcrop data; scientifically most defensible for overburden thickness in PEC. Not downloaded/verified pixel-level here.
options.licence: Open Government Licence - Ontario (https://www.ontario.ca/page/open-government-licence-ontario) (confirm on record)

options.title: SoilGrids250m (2017) BDTICM - absolute depth to bedrock (Shangguan et al. 2017)
options.access: https://files.isric.org/soilgrids/former/2017-03-10/data/BDTICM_M_250m_ll.tif (8.5 GB int32 GeoTIFF, EPSG:4326, 250 m, NOT tiled (strip), has overviews; HTTP range requests + CORS *). Read remotely with GDAL/rasterio /vsicurl/ and clip the PEC bbox in the pipeline - verified.
options.why_not_primary: Global model badly overestimates in PEC, where soils are commonly <1 m over Ordovician limestone (OGS mapped 71 'Paleozoic bedrock' polygons in PEC). Use only with heavy caveats.

options.title: Proxy: OGS MRD128-REV unit 3 'Paleozoic bedrock' / 4 'bedrock-drift complex' (and soil survey shallow-phase soils)
options.access: Use the ogs_surficial_geology layer below; categorical shallow-bedrock indicator, not a depth.

provenance.limitations: No AAFC SLGC depth-to-bedrock product exists in the 100 m release.

layers.title: Clay (SLGC 100m)

point_query.notes: ArcGIS ImageServer getSamples, multidimensional. Returns one sample per depth (Depth = -5/-15/-30 meaning 0-5/5-15/15-30 cm). value is a string; '' means NoData. Depth-weighted 0-30 cm mean = (5*v5 + 10*v15 + 15*v30)/30. Alternative: /identify with mosaicRule values:[d] returns {value:'22.436'} or 'NoData'. To change the displayed depth, swap values:[-15] in the tile URL mosaicRule. JSON in the URL MUST stay percent-encoded so MapLibre does not treat { } as placeholders.

layers.title: Clay - ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (fallback)
layers.status: WORKS (tiles + REST point query); WMS GetFeatureInfo does NOT work

point_query.method: ISRIC SoilGrids REST API v2.0 properties/query (GET)
point_query.value_path: properties.layers[0].depths[k].values.mean (integer in mapped units; null = NoData); divide by properties.layers[0].unit_measure.d_factor
point_query.notes: Layer names: {prop}_{0-5cm|5-15cm|15-30cm|30-60cm|60-100cm|100-200cm}_{mean|Q0.05|Q0.5|Q0.95|uncertainty}. REST API is labelled beta with fair-use limit (~5 req/min) - cache results; ~0.3-5 s latency. WMS GetFeatureInfo (text/plain, gml, geo+json; 1.1.1 and 1.3.0) always returned 'Search returned no results' - unusable. Alternative verified: WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage https://maps.isric.org/mapserv?map=/map/clay.map&SERVICE=WCS&VERSION=2.0.1&REQUEST=GetCoverage&COVERAGEID=clay_0-5cm_mean&FORMAT=image/tiff&SUBSET=long(minlon,maxlon)&SUBSET=lat(minlat,maxlat)&SUBSETTINGCRS=http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326&OUTPUTCRS=http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326 (int16 GeoTIFF, 0=NoData, CORS *) - good for a one-off pipeline clip of PEC.

layers.cors_notes: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on WMS, WCS and REST API.

legend.notes: Legend PNG (~57x500) labelled in mapped units (e.g. g/kg, dg/kg), not %.

recommendations.texture_soc: Use SLGC 100m (slgc_clay/sand/silt/soc) for tiles and getSamples; fall back to SoilGrids REST where SLGC returns '' (NoData). Consider baking both into PMTiles for PEC to avoid runtime dependency and the large SLGC gaps.
recommendations.cli: Bake CLI 250k GeoJSON (178 KB) into public/; offer OMAFRA Soil Survey Complex CLI as the detailed layer.
recommendations.surficial_geology: Bake MRD128-REV GeoJSON (simplified) or PMTiles; LIO 1:1M quaternary only as raster fallback.
recommendations.depth_to_bedrock: Offline: OGS MRD207 overburden thickness (preferred) -> clip/tile in pipeline; SoilGrids 2017 BDTICM only with explicit caveats.
recommendations.basemaps: OpenFreeMap positron/liberty + Esri World Imagery (attributed); EOX s2cloudless as an open-licence imagery fallback.
